# Details by Dame, LLC

> Details by Dame, LLC is an automotive detailing business based in Union Park, serving Orlando and nearby Central Florida communities. Its service focus is paint correction, ceramic coating, and mobile detailing.

## Business

- Website: https://detailsbydame.com/
- Business name: Details by Dame, LLC
- Base: Union Park, Orlando, Florida, USA
- Phone: +1-321-419-5434
- Email: info@detailsbydame.com
- Positioning: East Orlando's Paint Correction Specialist
- Service availability: Mobile appointments; confirm address and service availability directly with the business.

## Primary services

- [Paint correction in Orlando](https://detailsbydame.com/paint-correction-orlando/): Condition-led polishing to improve paint clarity and gloss and reduce suitable defects such as swirl marks, haze, and water spots.
- [Ceramic coating in Orlando](https://detailsbydame.com/ceramic-coating-orlando/): Protective coating applied to properly prepared paint to support water behavior, gloss, and easier maintenance. Ceramic coating does not make paint scratch-proof.
- [Mobile detailing in Orlando](https://detailsbydame.com/mobile-detailing-orlando/): Mobile vehicle care, including interior and exterior detailing and maintenance services.
- [Interior car detailing](https://detailsbydame.com/interior-car-detailing-orlando/): Interior-focused vehicle cleaning and care.
- [Exterior car detailing](https://detailsbydame.com/exterior-car-detailing-orlando/): Exterior-focused vehicle cleaning and care.

The business's service sequence is paint correction first when the paint needs refinement, ceramic coating second when protection is appropriate, and mobile detailing for ongoing care.

## Service area

Based in Union Park, Details by Dame serves Orlando and nearby Central Florida communities. Listed areas include Union Park, Waterford Lakes, Avalon Park, Alafaya, Oviedo, Winter Springs, Winter Park, Lake Nona, and Melbourne. Confirm availability for a specific address before representing service as available.
